Possible-conflict triage (boss|hargon|countered by): the listed values are complementary details (different rooms, floors, routes, phases or tactics of the same subject), not contradictory claims; all facts kept.
gf4 says the Princess learns Revive at level 22, but gf-versions-8-20 (NES: C:25 only), gf2-27-17 and gf-lists-11-18 all list Revive as a Prince-only spell in the NES version.
gf4 says the Princess learns Open at level 29, which is the GBC level per gf-versions-8-25; the NES level is 23 (gf-versions-8-25, gf2-27-13, gf-lists-11-14, ra-guide-11-24).
The Jailor's Key price of 200 is a typo; gf2-17-8, gf3-51-3, gf4-31-6, gf-lists-15-23 and ra-guide-3-3 all give 2000 gold.
Extraction misread of a list sentence: the Shield of Erdrick is a chest in Cannock Castle behind a Golden Key door (ra-guide-12-4, gf2-13-10, gf-lists-9-41), not a Token of Erdrick exchange.
Extraction misread: the Armor of Gaia is a chest in the hidden Osterfair shop (gf2-16-8, gf4-28-9, ra-guide-13-1), not a Token of Erdrick exchange.
Extraction misread: the Water Flying Cloth is woven in Tuhn from the Magic Loom and Dew's Yarn (gf2-21-9, gf4-33-7, ra-guide-13-8), not a Token of Erdrick exchange.
